name: Talk test, adaptive
noteHint: Sleep last night, hours and quality
notes: Finds the zone 2 ceiling in three 10-minute steps. Change only the resistance to reach each heart-rate band, and give each change about a minute to show in your heart rate before adjusting again. At the end of each step, count aloud 1 to 20. The ceiling is the last step where counting stays smooth. If a breath is needed in step 1 or 2, the rest of the ride runs 5 bpm lower. In step 3, never go above 132.

steps.title: Warm-up
steps.cue: Build gradually. Sit upright with a loose grip.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.cue: Settle into 115 to 120. Change resistance only.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.cue: Add a level or two. Settle into 120 to 125.

steps.title: Cool-down
steps.cue: Spin easily, then stop any watch recording.
